top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and its translation into long-acting incretin therapies is a mature, independently confirmed achievement. A citation anchored on physiology plus translation (Drucker, Holst, Knudsen) avoids a priority judgement on the active-peptide history that the supplied record cannot settle. P002 (Mojsov in place of Knudsen) is a defensible physiology-centred alternative and ranks well above no award, since the discovery clearly merits a prize.
